behavior: herdr accepts the explorer bindings and the sidebar ordering, on the source config and on the deployed copy
dotf herdr explorer splits the active pane to the right, at that pane's directory and ratio, and runs yazi in the new pane
a second invocation in the same tab closes the running explorer and opens nothing; another tab's explorer is left alone
a machine without yazi gets a refusal that names the provisioner instead of an empty pane
yazi is provisioned by a mise pin, and the pin reaches the rendered mise config from the checkout
each shell wrapper names its own agent in HERDR_AGENT, so herdr detects a wrapped pane instead of reporting agent: null
